Original description

First described in 2008:

Drosera ericgreenii A.Fleischm., R.P.Gibson & Rivadavia, Bothalia 38(2): 141 (-144; fig. 1, map). 2008 [14 Oct 2008]

IPNI record

Range given in the IPNI record of that publication: Western Cape Province (Cape Provinces, Southern Africa, Africa).

How well the identifier knows it

Of 13 validation photos of Drosera ericgreenii (photos the model never trained on), its top guess was right for 8. It gave a confident answer for 9 of them, and 6 of those were right.

Only 28 training photos: species with fewer than 40 are identified less reliably.

Most often mistaken for

  • Drosera hilaris (5 photos)
